dialogue_history.content: What is meant by "low and medium precision"?
"Low and medium precision" refers to robots with an Average Position Error (APE) greater than or equal to 0.1.
What is meant by "higher chance of issues"?
"Higher chance of issues" refers to robots with a Recent Fault Prediction Score (RFPS) greater than 0.5, indicating a higher likelihood of experiencing faults or issues.
What is the definition of "large Robot Age"?

In this context, "large Robot Age" refers to robots that have been in operation for more than 1 year. The calculation for Robot Age in Years (RAY) is derived from the difference between the robot's record timestamp and its installation date, converted into years.

"APE Rank" refers to the percentile rank of the Average Position Error (APE) within each controller type. It is calculated using the `PERCENT_RANK()` window function, which ranks the APE values in descending order for each controller type, giving a relative measure of how each robot's precision compares to others within the same controller group.

args.sql:
WITH robot_age AS (
    SELECT 
        botdetreg, 
        DATE_PART('year', rects - instdateval) AS robot_age_years
    FROM robot_details
    INNER JOIN robot_record USING (recreg)
), 
robot_precision AS (
    SELECT 
        actdetref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN poserrmmval >= 0.1 THEN 'Low/Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS precision_category
    FROM actuation_data
), 
robot_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot, 
        CASE 
            WHEN faultpredscore > 0.5 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS issue_chance
    FROM maintenance_and_fault
), 
robot_ape AS (
    SELECT 
        actdetref, 
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ctrltypeval ORDER BY poserrmmval DESC) AS ape_rank
    FROM actuation_data
    INNER JOIN robot_details USING (botdetreg)
), 
robot_info AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
        AVG(ad.poserrmmval) AS avg_position_error, 
        MAX(ra.ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
        AVG(mf.faultpredscore) AS avg_recent_fault_prediction_score, 
        COUNT(rr.botcode) AS robot_count
    FROM robot_details rd
    INNER JOIN robot_age ra USING (botdetreg)
    INNER JOIN robot_precision rp ON rd.botdetreg = rp.actdetref
    INNER JOIN robot_issues ri ON rd.botdetreg = ri.upkeeprobot
    INNER JOIN robot_ape raa ON rd.botdetreg = raa.actdetref
    INNER JOIN robot_record rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.recreg
    INNER JOIN actuation_data ad ON rd.botdetreg = ad.actdetref
    INNER JOIN maintenance_and_fault mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    WHERE 
        rp.precision_category = 'Low/Medium' 
        AND ri.issue_chance = 'High' 
        AND ra.robot_age_years > 1
    GROUP BY rd.ctrltypeval
)
SELECT * 
FROM robot_info
LIMIT 10;
